title: Midterm Exam Schedule Released
content: The midterm examination schedule for all courses has been published. Please check the notice board and your course pages for exact dates and venues.

title: Library Extended Hours
content: The central library will remain open until 10 PM during the exam period (Sept 20 - Oct 5).

title: Career Fair 2026
content: Annual Career Fair will be held on October 15. Over 50 companies will participate. Register online by October 1.

title: Holiday Notice
content: College will remain closed on September 25 for the local festival. Classes will resume on September 26.
